notes.title: My Ex-Future Family Season 2 Episode 3 released!
notes.content:
Well, it's time to talk about the features of the new episode:

[list]
[*] 300+ artwork, of course in full HD quality :)
[*] 25 new sex animations, hot and exciting ;)
[*] from 40 to 70 minutes of gameplay (and, if you go through all the branches, a little more)
[*] new hidden pictures and achievements
[*] prepared an interesting update with cats, in general super-cool additional content
[*] 3+ new sex scenes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41756570/e7d9117edd947f46df62f767ca01f95040f08c29.jpg[/img]

And this is what's ready from the prologue to the end of episode three:
[list]
[*] almost 2000 full HD artwork! 
[*] 160+ beautiful animations 
[*] over 5 hours of gameplay
[*] many hidden pictures and more than 30 Achievements
[*] replayability :)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41756570/a85218a9990801820a99f562ede137c63ca38062.jpg[/img]

This week we'll finish posting additional content to Season 1 page of our game. You're going to love it :)

We will try to release announcements in Steam every week, so you can follow the progress of our work and can appreciate some art from the future game.

Thank you for being with us and see you soon! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41756570/cc06a528871ac779a2b3571dcc04b89b0f66fe68.jpg[/img]

And don't forget to add to your Wishlist and hit the follow button to keep up with the latest news!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692280/My_ExFuture_Family_Season_2/

notes.title: MEFF Artbook and MEFF Calendar 2025 are avaliable on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We continue to create content for our new games, but we try not to forget about the projects we have successfully completed.

I'll keep it simple, post a list of what's new, show you some pretty pictures and hint at what the next big update for our game will be.

But! First, nice boobs! We all love boobs! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751520/c4e23f2cbe9c05a19a3bc40b24e11305111355c9.jpg[/img]

Now we can move on to the list of new things:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751520/20ca6b80d7459c073b0b1a568197e238d30f3141.jpg[/img]

1) An Artbook with cool art from each chapter. We had a long discussion about which pictures to choose. We have the idea was to limit the number of pictures from each episode. 
We are glad to present to you: our Artbook. Enjoy :-)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3097580/My_Exfuture_Family_Artbook/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751520/f68f384c1fbcdddc6ce18c43d345eae0e8e2e249.jpg[/img]

2) Calendar for 2025. We have been thinking for a long time how we can say thank you again to those who buy the premium version of the game. We have added a calendar to the premium version of the game and increased the discount by 15% for those who buy the bandle.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3097890/My_Exfuture_Family_Calendar_2025/


In general, I think there's a lot of news and it's useful, so I thought I'd shove a link to our project in development, My Ex-Future Family 2, Reload, in at the end once again:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692280/My_ExFuture_Family_Season_2/

Add it to your Wishlist! See you on Steam ;-)
